description: Validated AOH1996 cryptic pocket on human PCNA. Ground-truth positive control for the whole MD-validation harness.

provenance.method: PCNA heavy-atom distance <= 4.5 A to ligand ZQZ in co-crystal 8GLA
provenance.note: This list REPLACES the older hand-curated run_md.py list, which omitted the IDCL contacts 121/124/129/131 and added 42 under a false '6 A' provenance comment (bio-validity audit, medium finding).

caveat: Per governance doc 12, this region overlaps known interfaces (PIP-box / IDCL / C-terminus). Recovering it is positive-control overlap with a KNOWN site, NOT evidence of a novel druggable pocket. The ZQZ ligand contacts residues across two PCNA chains, so the pocket is a genuine two-subunit interface site.
apo_role: true apo PCNA homotrimer (pocket CLOSED). Question: does the pocket transiently open?
control_role: holo PCNA, ligand ZQZ stripped (pocket starts OPEN). POSITIVE CONTROL: the openness metric MUST read larger here than apo, else the method cannot see opening and any apo result is inconclusive, not negative.
residue_numbering: PDB author (auth_seq_id). Identical across PCNA structures because they share one canonical 261-aa sequence (UniProt P12004).
_schema_note: To validate a NEW GNN-predicted pocket, copy this file, set pocket_name / pocket_residues_resseq (the GNN's site) / apo_pdb / control_pdb, then run `run_md.py --pocket <name>`. If no holo structure exists for the novel site, set control_pdb to null: the harness will then report 'no positive control -> inconclusive' rather than a false negative.
